Emma (Docs): quick check before merging PR #4237: three small issues in the examples bundle (py/ts/go) that can cause confusing behaviour for copy-pasters.
Will (SDK): what are the issues?
Emma (Docs): 1) Python streaming snippet iterates but never shows resource cleanup; on some runtimes that can leave background tasks/sockets alive. 2) TS retry sample has no maxDelay/attempt cap. 3) Go pagination loop doesn't guard against empty cursor and can re-request first page on some backends.
Samira: thanks for catching. Minimal safe changes would be best.
Emma (Docs): Python proposed patch: prefer async context manager and include a one-line fallback for older SDKs:
```py
# preferred: ensures resources are cleaned up automatically
import asyncio

async def example():
    async with client.stream(prompt) as s:
        async for chunk in s:
            print(chunk)

asyncio.run(example())
```
Fallback (older SDKs):
```py
stream = client.stream(prompt)
async for c in stream:
    print(c)
await client.close()  # ensure background tasks are stopped
```
Will (SDK): add a tiny comment explaining why to avoid confusion.
Emma (Docs): done in the diff. TS suggestion (conservative defaults + abort on non-retriable errors):
```ts
// conservative defaults to avoid long waits
const retryCfg = { baseMs: 200, factor: 2, maxDelayMs: 4000, attempts: 6, jitter: true };
await sdk.generate({ prompt }, { retry: retryCfg });
// note: abort immediately on 4xx (non-retriable) responses
```
Ben (Go SDK): for Go pagination current pattern is: resp, _ := client.List(ctx, nil); for resp.HasMore() { resp, _ = client.List(ctx, resp.NextCursor()) } which can loop if NextCursor() == "". Suggest this safe loop:
```go
resp, _ := client.List(ctx, nil)
for {
  if !resp.HasMore() { break }
  next := resp.NextCursor()
  if next == "" { break } // backend returned empty cursor; stop to avoid repeated pages
  resp, _ = client.List(ctx, next)
}
```
Ben (Go SDK): I'll add a tiny examples_test.go unit test that returns an empty cursor to ensure the loop exits.
